label: Predictive Maintenance
info: Real-time predictive maintenance using InfluxDB trend analysis

name: Get Unit List
func:
const units = ['CS-01', 'CS-02', 'CS-03'];
return [units.map(unitId => ({ payload: unitId, unitId: unitId }))];

name: Build InfluxDB Query
func:
const unitId = msg.unitId;

// Single query that returns temp trend, avg energy, compressor ON% in last 1h
const fluxQuery = `
tempData = from(bucket: "cold_storage")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["unitId"] == "${unitId}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "temperature")

tempFirst = tempData |> first() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
tempLast  = tempData |> last()  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
tempMean  = tempData |> mean()  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

energyMean = from(bucket: "cold_storage")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["unitId"] == "${unitId}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyConsumption")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

compTotal = from(bucket: "cold_storage")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["unitId"] == "${unitId}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "compressorStatus")
  |> count()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

compOn = from(bucket: "cold_storage")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensor_data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["unitId"] == "${unitId}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "compressorStatus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] == "ON")
  |> count()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

union(
  tables: [
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "tempFirst",   _value: tempFirst._value}]),
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "tempLast",    _value: tempLast._value}]),
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "tempMean",    _value: tempMean._value}]),
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "energyMean",  _value: energyMean._value}]),
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "compTotal",   _value: float(v: compTotal._value)}]),
    array.from(rows: [{_field: "compOn",      _value: float(v: compOn._value)}])
  ]
)`;

msg.payload = fluxQuery;
msg.headers = {
    'Authorization': 'Token smart-cooling-super-secret-token',
    'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.flux',
    'Accept': 'application/csv'
};
msg.url = 'http://influxdb:8086/api/v2/query?org=smart_cooling';
msg.method = 'POST';
return msg;
